ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. quickly

3. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a describing word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

7. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. goed

11. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

12. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
